name: og_34_chemical_heredity_and_selection
description: Gate D second half: selection on an inherited NETWORK COMPOSITION trait in a protocell population (⚑3 Option B; template copying = follow-on og-34a). Fitness is grounded in the real study-32/33 coupling (composition -> membrane retention [study-32 MD endpoints 0.333/0.661] -> standing pool -> division rate). inheritance=False is the matched no-inheritance null (daughters reset to the common composition). Reports parent-offspring fitness correlation + population composition shift; the vasas-2010 evolvability caveat is TESTED (does the population shift above the null?), not assumed. Metabolism = sustained A1 network, NOT autocatalytic (A2 refuted).

emitter.doc:
Generic Parquet emitter, hive-partitioned per ``partitioning_keys``.

The process-bigraph lifecycle drives the emit cadence:

  - configuration is written at ``__init__`` time from ``config["metadata"]``
    (only when ``metadata`` is non-None);
  - history rows arrive via ``update(state)`` per composite tick;
  - ``close(success=...)`` flushes the buffer and (when ``success=True``
    and a partitioning layout is configured) writes the success sentinel.

Durability-sensitive callers must call ``close()`` explicitly at end of
composite run; ``__del__`` calls it defensively but interpreter-shutdown
ordering is undefined.
